svg.text: A MONTHLY RECAP OF TATER TOT McGEE’S FIRST PRO SEASON
Tater Tot McGee’s final month in Triple-A before his promotion to Seattle.
10 total bases: his July AAA high.
July 4: two HR and a double.
with two HR and five RBI.
